premise: A shadow crosses your window, then vanishes. What do you think happened, and what will you do?
scene_context: A shadow crosses your cottage window, but you cannot see what made it.

rows.name: MOCHI
rows.reply: It was likely just a trick of the wind, but I will grab my lantern and lock the door.

rows.name: PIPKIN
rows.reply: The intruder slipped past me, but I will not stay still. I will grab my weapon and hunt them down.
